name: c4fy
description: Create source-backed C4 context, container, component, and code diagrams as standalone HTML with a soft rounded UI, animated C1/C2/C3/C4 drill-down, source details, automatic domain/type/role classification, and SVG/JSON export. Use for C4 architecture maps and hierarchical system explanations, including optional component-level code structure; not for generic flowcharts or sequence diagrams.

interface.shortDescription: C1/C2/C3/C4 diagrams with domain colors, type shapes and role icons
interface.longDescription: Create source-backed C4 context, container, component, and code diagrams as standalone HTML with a soft rounded UI, animated C1/C2/C3/C4 drill-down, source details, automatic domain/type/role classification, and SVG/JSON export. Use for C4 architecture maps and hierarchical system explanations, including optional component-level code structure; not for generic flowcharts or sequence diagrams.
defaultPrompt: Use $c4fy to create source-backed C4 context, container, component and optional code diagrams with domain/type/role classification and smooth animated transitions.
